name: llm-replication-disclosure
description: Replication-package assembly and disclosure checklist for research that uses LLM-generated data, measures, or code, based on Table A.3 and Sections 3.3.2-3.3.3 of Ferrara (2026, NBER WP 35374). Use this skill whenever the user is preparing a replication package, responding to a journal data editor, writing a generative-AI disclosure statement, drafting the methods or appendix section describing LLM use, submitting or revising a paper that used any LLM anywhere in the pipeline, or asks "what do I need to report / archive / disclose" about AI-assisted work. Also trigger proactively at the END of any project where Claude helped build an LLM pipeline — packaging requirements are cheapest to satisfy during the work, not after — and whenever the user mentions journal submission, data editors, replication files, ICPSR/openICPSR/Zenodo deposits, or reproducibility of model output.
